services:
  ec-qwen-abc123:
    image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.27.1
    command:
    - --model
    - Qwen/Qwen3-32B
    - --served-model-name
    - Qwen/Qwen3-32B
    - --port
    - '8000'
    - --chat-template
    - '{% for m in messages %}{{ m.content }} {% endfor %}'
    - --max-model-len
    - '32768'
    - --speculative-config
    - '{"method": "ngram", "num_speculative_tokens": 4, "prompt_lookup_max": 4}'
    restart: 'no'
    ipc: private
    shm_size: 16g
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /root/.cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: '1'
      VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL: INFO
      VLLM_API_KEY: ${VLLM_API_KEY}
    volumes:
    - /data/hf/hub:/root/.cache/huggingface/hub:ro
    - ec-vllm-cache:/root/.cache/vllm
    labels:
      engine-console: '1'
      engine-console.role: engine
      engine-console.instance: inst_abc
      engine-console.name: my long model name with spaces that goes past the eighty
        column fold
      engine-console.port: '18000'
      engine-console.gpu_ids: '0'
    networks:
    - engine-console-engines
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    pids_limit: 4096
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
          - driver: nvidia
            device_ids:
            - GPU-aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee
            capabilities:
            - gpu
